mining_new_block:
[[injection]]
id = "source-native-mining-context"
target = "horizon_client::game::native_hooks::Game<'_>::native_break_speed"
kind = "HEAD"
helper = "source-mining-context-native.rs"
bindings = [
  { name = "game", ty = "&crate::game::Game<'_>", value = "self" },
  { name = "pos", ty = "[i32; 3]", value = "pos" },
  { name = "state", ty = "horizon_world::registry::BlockStateId", value = "state" },
  { name = "speed", ty = "&mut f32", value = "&mut *speed" },
]
mining_old_block:
[[injection]]
id = "source-host-mining-context"
target = "horizon_client::game::Game<'_>::tick_mining"
kind = "MODIFY_VARIABLE"
variable = { name = "speed", ordinal = 0, at = "LOAD" }
require = 2
ordinal = 1
helper = "source-mining-context-host.rs"
bindings = [{ name = "speed", ty = "f32", value = "$value" }, { name = "game", ty = "&crate::game::Game<'_>", value = "&*self" }, { name = "facts", ty = "&&horizon_items::blocks::StateFacts", value = "$local_ref:facts:0" }, { name = "held", ty = "&Option<&ItemStack>", value = "$local_ref:held:0" }]

[[injection]]
id = "source-client-mining-context"
target = "horizon_client::game::hand::Game<'_>::destroy_progress"
kind = "MODIFY_VARIABLE"
variable = { name = "speed", ordinal = 0, at = "LOAD" }
require = 2
ordinal = 1
helper = "source-mining-context.rs"
bindings = [{ name = "speed", ty = "f32", value = "$value" }, { name = "game", ty = "&crate::game::Game<'_>", value = "&*self" }, { name = "facts", ty = "&&horizon_items::blocks::StateFacts", value = "$local_ref:facts:0" }, { name = "held", ty = "&Option<&ItemStack>", value = "$local_ref:held:0" }, { name = "pos", ty = "[i32; 3]", value = "pos" }]
